method.normalization: Remove whitespace/comments; replace identifiers and string/number literals for normalized JS comparison. Preserve operators and keyword/token kinds. CSS comparison is literal-token only. Svelte script only; markup excluded. JSON palettes assessed separately.
method.positiveControls: Exact copy and renamed identifiers detected; negative control rejected.
method.limitations: Contiguous lexical matches only, not AST/semantic similarity. No template-string interpolation parsing. No claim of global originality or legal clearance.
